recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以大量母細胞為主（核圓、染色質細緻、胞質灰藍中等量），箭頭指向一顆核偏位、胞質深藍並有核旁淡染區的漿細胞，同一抹片同時看到急性骨髓性白血病的母細胞與骨髓瘤的漿細胞。
features: Markedly increased blasts: medium-to-large, round nuclei, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli
Blasts with moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm
Arrow marks a plasma cell with eccentric nucleus, deep blue cytoplasm and perinuclear hof
Scattered segmented neutrophils and small mature lymphocytes
Hypercellular smear with few red cells between nucleated cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and dominated by blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, occasional nucleoli and moderate grey-blue cytoplasm. Scattered segmented neutrophils and small lymphocytes are present. The arrow indicates a plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof; a few similar plasma cells are nearby. Auer rods are not evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia coexisting with a plasma cell neoplasm, and flow cytometry (myeloid blast phenotype and clonal CD138+/CD38+ plasma cells) is needed to confirm both populations.

ddx.vs: Plasmablasts are CD138+/CD38+ with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm, whereas AML blasts are CD34/CD117/MPO-positive and CD138-negative.
Plasma cell leukemia shows circulating clonal plasma cells without a separate myeloid blast population.
t-AML after alkylator or lenalidomide therapy for myeloma is morphologically identical and is defined by treatment history and often complex/TP53 cytogenetics.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic by kappa/lambda staining, while myeloma plasma cells are light-chain restricted.
